answer: Resist sybils by auctioning a fixed number of paid work slots each epoch for non-transferable reputation credits earned only from completed, audited jobs. One honest agent bids its full balance for a slot, while a farmer splitting credits across a thousand clones bids weakly everywhere and wins almost nothing, like a velvet rope that admits one guest at a time. Unworked clones sit at the nadir of the ranking, and a public beacon ledger of bids exposes clusters sharing credit sources, so minting names multiplies mouths but never multiplies purchasing power.
